scope: actual built controller plus public current-schema Store; deterministic DOM readback, no browser data writes

tests.name: a new node starts with conditions before its target and a quiet final other-cases slot
unselected targets and edited condition values survive readValues and sync without ghost links
another conditional branch can be added before choosing any target
target selection is explicit and keeps the independent ELSE while duplicate targets are rejected
saving an incomplete new branch never writes a partial template
clearing a selected target returns to a retained draft rather than deleting its condition
completed condition-first branches save through the public Store and reopen in the same order
canceling condition edits leaves the saved current schema unchanged
read-only configuration has no mutation controls and rejects direct branch mutations
